title: Placement assessment
entry: Take or retake the assessment and review your suggested starting plan.
invite: You have not completed a placement assessment. Try it for a suggested learning plan.
description: 20–30 vocabulary, kanji and grammar questions, plus listening when suitable audio is available. Start at N5; difficulty adapts to your answers. You can pause and return later.
disclaimer: This is a learning estimate, not an official JLPT result.
kanjiPrompt: Choose the reading of this kanji
vocabPrompt: Choose the meaning of this word
listeningPrompt: Listen to the audio segment and transcribe the Japanese sentence
reorder: Select the parts in order to build the sentence.
ceiling: Estimated up to {{level}}. The bank currently has sufficient data up to {{ceiling}}; higher levels have not been verified.
evidenceRule: A level above N5 requires at least 2 vocabulary, 2 kanji and 2 grammar questions at that level, with at least 70% correct in each skill. N5 is the foundation starting point when evidence is insufficient.
foundation: Strengthen your N5 foundations before increasing difficulty.
roadmap: Start at {{level}}. Spend 15–20 minutes daily reviewing {{skills}}, alongside grammar, vocabulary and kanji. Retake in 2 weeks to adjust your plan.
confirmationNote: Your profile JLPT level changes only when you confirm this suggestion.
requiredSetup: Complete and confirm your placement assessment to set your level before using the app. Your progress is saved so you can resume after signing in again.
statusUnavailable: Your placement setup status could not be checked. Reload to continue.
setupDescription: Choose the assessment that suits you.
chooseMode: How would you like to assess your level?
modeAdaptiveTitle: I do not know my level yet
modeAdaptiveDescription: Take an adaptive assessment to estimate N5–N1. Difficulty responds to several answers; estimates are bounded by verified content.
modeConfirmationDescription: Choose a level and assess whether it suits your skills.
selectionDoesNotSetLevel: Selecting a level chooses the assessment; it does not change your profile.
unavailableExplanation: Dimmed levels lack enough questions across all five skills. Another level is never substituted silently.
bankUnavailable: The bank lacks enough questions for this selection. Reload or resume your previous attempt.
demoNotice: This N5 demonstration uses SenpaiAI-authored questions and existing seed audio. Demo scores do not establish a profile level or constitute official JLPT results.
requiredSetupCompact: Complete the assessment and save the result to set up your plan. Submitted progress is saved automatically.
activeAttempt: You have an assessment in progress
replaceAttempt: Starting a new assessment will close the active attempt while preserving its history and answers. Continue?
legacyResult: This result belongs to the previous assessment version. Its history is preserved.
timeExpired: Time expired. The result uses answers received by the server before the deadline.
passageTitle: Read the passage and answer the question
adaptiveLocked: This answer was committed to choose the next difficulty. You may review it but cannot change it.
autosaveNote: Answers save when navigating. Adaptive responses commit on Next; correct answers stay hidden during the assessment.
readyToSubmit: Enough questions have been collected under the assessment rules. Submit to see the result.
submitConfirmation: {{count}} delivered questions are unanswered. Blanks score zero; insufficient evidence will not establish a level. Submit?
backToSetup: Back to mode selection, keeping saved progress
insufficientEvidence: Insufficient evidence to establish a level
evidenceSufficient: Sufficient evidence under the internal rules; the result remains an estimate.
evidenceInsufficient: Skill evidence is incomplete or this assessment uses demo content. No unverified level is assigned automatically.
saveReferenceNote: Save this attempt to continue learning. Any confirmed level is preserved; otherwise N5 is only a foundational content fallback.
trendNote: Compare attempts only within the same mode, level and scoring version. Demo or insufficient evidence does not show proficiency trends.

sources.manual_override: Manually assigned level; placement assessment waived

outcomes.strong: Strong performance at the tested level. Try the next level when available; it has not been established.
outcomes.suitable: Performance suits the tested level under internal thresholds.
outcomes.try_lower: Performance does not meet this level’s thresholds. Try a lower level; it has not been established automatically.
outcomes.insufficient: More valid responses are needed before reaching a conclusion.
